name: Core loop audit and hardening
description: The core cmd_run() loop has grown complex with self-healing, telemetry, and model selection. This PRD audits the loop, removes dead code paths, and ensures the happy path is bulletproof. No new features - just hardening.

userStories.title: Audit cmd_run() for dead code and unreachable branches
userStories.description: Review the main execution loop for code that can never execute or conditions that can never be true.
acceptanceCriteria: Document all code paths in cmd_run() with a simple flowchart comment
Remove any unreachable code or impossible conditions
Ensure all exit paths are covered: STORY_DONE, ALL_COMPLETE, BLOCKED, no-signal

userStories.title: Verify signal detection is robust
userStories.description: The BUG-007 fix added strict pattern matching. Verify it works in all scenarios.
acceptanceCriteria: Run all 6 BUG-007 tests and confirm they pass
Add 2 additional edge case tests: signal at EOF, signal with trailing whitespace
Document signal patterns in a comment block near detect logic

userStories.title: Simplify iteration counter and loop bounds
userStories.description: The loop has multiple iteration counters and bounds checks. Consolidate to single clear counter.
acceptanceCriteria: Clear log message when max iterations reached

technicalNotes.rationale: This is careful refactoring work that requires understanding existing code. Sonnet is appropriate for medium complexity.
